eval: (()=>{const A=__game.game.assets,P=__game.game.world.props;const v=P.villagers[3];const bones={};v.mesh.traverse(b=>{if(b.isBone)bones[b.name]=b;});const cl=A.clips('fisherman');const idle=cl.find(c=>/idle/i.test(c.name));const rows=[];for(const t of idle.tracks){if(t.name.indexOf('.position')<0)continue;const bn=t.name.split('.')[0];const b=bones[bn];if(!b)continue;const dx=t.values[0]-b.position.x,dy=t.values[1]-b.position.y,dz=t.values[2]-b.position.z;const bl=b.position.length();rows.push(bn+' bindLen'+bl.toFixed(3)+' delta'+Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz).toFixed(3));}return JSON.stringify(rows);})()
